mapper.sql: id, username, email, nickname, password_hash, password_salt, role, uid, profile, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, username, email, nickname, password_hash, password_salt, role, uid, profile, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{passwordHash}, #{passwordSalt}, #{role}, #{uid}, #{profile,typeHandler=com.tabletop.persistence.FastjsonMapTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_salt = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET role = #{role}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
